high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Stand by Me," directed by Rob Reiner. The poster features a serene landscape with a body of water in the foreground and silhouetted hills in the background under a clear sky. The overall color scheme is dominated by shades of blue and black, creating a calm and reflective atmosphere. At the top of the poster, there is a dialogue box with two lines of text that read: "If I could only have one food to eat for the rest of my life?" "That's easy. Pez. Cherry flavor Pez. No question about it."
